13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark theme with intentional complementary hover colors (blue/orange) and good opacity hierarchy, but the default low-bundling tension leaves the center a dense, tangled mass that undermines the diagram's core purpose at rest.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.encoding_integrity_note: No quantitative magnitude encoding to violate; structural layout is honest, but the tension slider displays 0.85 while applying curveBundle.beta(1-0.85)=0.15 — inverting the label/value relationship and misrepresenting bundling strength to the user.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires `input` continuously during drag, calling `linkSelection.attr('d', line)` on all ~80 paths every event with no RAF coalescing or debounce; all other interactions (hover class-swaps, no transitions, single-view) are clean.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.cognitive_load_note: At-rest state is dense (~87 nodes, ~80 edges producing a tangled center) but the hover interaction rescues it with well-calibrated fade-out and directional blue/orange encoding that makes individual dependency paths immediately traceable.
